title: Add extended badge criteria to admin tab and reverse leaderboard date sort

requirements.text: Extend the badge creation form in the Admin tab (BadgeManagement.tsx) to support all the following additional criteria types, each with an appropriate numeric threshold input: (1) totalDaysAvailable – number of days with availability set, (2) totalGamesPlayed – total games played milestones, (3) firstMatchLogged – first match logged (boolean/threshold of 1), (4) winPercentage – win percentage threshold (e.g. 60, 75), (5) bestWinStreak – best win streak milestones, (6) totalChatMessages – number of chat messages posted, (7) totalLikesReceived – number of likes received on chat messages, (8) firstImageUploaded – first image uploaded in chat (boolean/threshold of 1), (9) topLeaderboardPosition – reaching top N leaderboard position (e.g. 1, 3), (10) daysAtNumber1 – number of days holding the #1 leaderboard spot, (11) monthlyParticipation – matches played in a given month, (12) consecutiveWeeksAvailable – availability logged for X consecutive weeks. The existing criteria types (totalWins, winsStreak, totalGames) must remain unchanged.

quotes: Can we add all this criteria to the admin tab for creating badges?

acceptanceCriteria: The badge creation/edit modal in the Admin tab displays all 12 new criteria types in the criteria type dropdown alongside the existing ones.
Selecting any new criteria type shows an appropriate threshold/value input field.
The backend BadgeCriteria type is extended to include all new criteria variants.
Existing badge creation with totalWins, winsStreak, and totalGames still works correctly.
New criteria types are persisted and displayed correctly when viewing existing badges.

requirements.text: In the Leaderboard page (LeaderboardPage.tsx), reverse the sort order of dates in the dropdown used to add wins or losses, so that the most recent dates appear at the top and the oldest dates appear at the bottom.

quotes: in leaderboard tab when a user selects a date in the drop down to add wins or losses, the dates are sorted oldest at the top to newest at the bottom but I want this reversed

acceptanceCriteria: The date dropdown in the Leaderboard tab lists dates in descending order (newest first, oldest last).
The previously selected or default date still resolves correctly after the sort is reversed.
No other leaderboard functionality is affected.

constraints: Do not remove or rename existing badge criteria types (totalWins, winsStreak, totalGames).
Do not modify immutable frontend paths listed in the system context.
nonGoals: Automatically awarding the new badge criteria to users (only the admin creation UI and backend type definitions are in scope).
Changing the sort order of any other list or dropdown outside the leaderboard date selector.
